sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. An almost frontal head-and-upper-chest portrait with a slight head turn, a high receding forehead and short neatly side-combed grey-brown hair, including visible temple hair. Thin separate grey-brown eyebrows sit above and partly behind thick dark brown-black rounded-square eyeglass frames with a dark bridge and visible temples. The upper lip, cheeks and chin are clean-shaven; preserve the smooth face and do not turn the faint upper-lip/chin shading into a moustache or beard. The eyes look mostly forward with a slightly raised gaze; there is one closed, restrained neutral mouth with a faint relaxed lift. No hat. He wears a brown civilian suit jacket with lapels over a pale cool grey pointed-collar shirt and a dark charcoal tie with lighter diagonal tonal bands and a centered knot. No visible medals, insignia or accessories other than the glasses. The shoulders extend through both side edges and the upper chest is cropped by the bottom edge; the whole hair silhouette remains inside the top edge. Soft frontal/upper-left light highlights the broad forehead and nose, with darker cheek, neck and jacket shadows. Preserve the complete softly textured pale beige-grey background, lighter above and darker grey-olive around the lower sides. This is an opaque painted rectangle without a separate photographic card, mounted frame, overlapping note, handwritten marks or exterior silhouette transparency. Actual source RGBA is 156 by 210 pixels and every one of the 32760 alpha samples is 255.
